name: Silkscreen Label Generator
description: Places silkscreen text under each selected component (or every component), filled from a template such as "{ref} {value}" or "{param:MPN}". Every run is a proposal you review, and applies as one undo step.

settings.title: Label text
settings.description: Fields: {ref}, {value}, {footprint}, {param:<Name>}. A label whose fields are all empty is skipped.

settings.title: Ask for the text each time
